commit_message: Align Timeline schema with ADR0126 first release
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR 0126 Timeline first release
pr_body:
## Summary

Continues ADR0126 first-release completion on current main. This batch narrows the persisted Timeline contract to the six required first-release track families, uses Animation Set motion-slot identity instead of raw importer clip ownership, validates a typed Transform/Property allowlist, permits non-spatial Audio tracks without an entity binding, and bounds Event data.

Keep this PR Draft and unmerged while runtime composition, Project Rust controls/views, packaged-player integration, Sequencer authoring/preview, and required visual validation are completed.
